ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters forming circular patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular and semi-circular ring clusters are distributed globally across both fluke lobes, with the highest density observed along the trailing edges and terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the center-point with an estimated pixel angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency and irregular serrations characterized by sharp, jagged peaks and deep valleys across the entire linear boundary from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the dorsal-facing trailing edges, terminating in elongated, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed constellations of circular white rings (consistent with barnacle attachment sites) covering the majority of the visible ventral surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring resulting in a 'pock-marked' appearance; physical erosion or significant irregularity at the terminal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Human-readable alphanumeric text overlay at bottom: TEC01-34/33a, ID 10789, TODD CHANDLER, S# N2-37, 11 Sept 01 Half Moon Bay.
